Kulkarni Assistant ProfessorB.Com, MBA (Finance and HR, Bangalore University), M.Com (Correspondence, University of Mysore) Linkedin Mrs. Pavana R. Kulkarni is an Assistant Professor in the BBA Department with 9 years of teaching experience at the undergraduate level. She holds an MBA in Finance and HR from Bangalore University and has also completed her M.Com through correspondence from the University of Mysore. She began her teaching career at NSVK College and has been with SSMRV College since 2019, contributing actively to the academic development of BBA students.
